create_bitmasks_from_tensor: create a BitMasks object from a 3D boolean tensor representing N instance masks in an image
convert_polygons_to_bitmask: convert a list of polygon coordinate arrays into a binary bitmask using pycocotools
rasterize_polygons_within_box: rasterize polygons into a cropped and resized mask tensor for Mask R-CNN training targets
create_polygonmasks_from_polygons: create a PolygonMasks object from a nested list of polygon coordinate arrays for instance segmentation
crop_and_resize_masks: crop each mask by its bounding box and resize to a fixed size for Mask R-CNN head training
